entries.reason: Signed native GStreamer1.28.7-2 package replaces the legacy helper; retain its standard installed CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE and CAP_NET_ADMIN capabilities after the package install script, and independently check its signed-package mtree bytes.
Claude's prepared RISC-V guard calls ufw-docker only when installed; the remaining package firewall rules are preserved. No personal firewall state is imported.
The prepared VM uses ext4; the three-line script performs no snapper setup on a non-btrfs root.
